description: Current Fleek prices for digital subscriptions, read live from Fleek's public catalogue. With a brand, returns each of its plans on sale with Fleek's price, list price (MRP), saving, duration, delivery (code or activation) and a link to the brand page. Without a brand, returns up to 8 brands (optionally in one category) with each brand's biggest saving. Brands and prices are those of the given country's store, in its currency.

category.description: streaming, music, news, antivirus, productivity, fitness, learning, lifestyle or gift cards (or the catalogue's own names such as OTT).

country.description: The user's country: a name, an ISO code (US, GB, AE, IN) or a currency (USD, ₹). Brands and prices differ by country. Omitted means Fleek's global store, in USD.

name: find_deals
title: Find subscription deals on Fleek
